description:
Having the freedom to pick a topic to speak about can be challenging. Are you feeling a little stumped about what to talk to your audience about?    

In this video, the 2018 World Champion of Public Speaking, Ramona J. Smith, shares advice on how to pick a topic that connects with your audience and keeps them engaged start to finish.
